methodology: GPM IMERG Final monthly precipitation, V07B reprocessed run (GPM_3IMERGM), version V07B, accessed through NASA GES DISC direct HDF5 download, 1-degree area mean as an area-averaged monthly time series, converted from mm/month to mm/month. Whole calendar years only. Trends are computed afterwards by the analysis module (seasonal Mann-Kendall with Sen's slope); this file describes the data only.
limitations: Each value is an average over the region's box, so it hides what happens inside the box.
Giovanni snaps the requested box to the product's grid; the region it actually analysed is recorded in the provenance.
MERRA-2 is a model reconstruction constrained by observations, not a direct measurement. Changes in what it assimilates can create artificial steps in a record.
Months with no value are kept as empty rows, never filled in.
attribution: GPM IMERG Final monthly precipitation, V07B reprocessed run (GPM_3IMERGM). NASA Goddard Earth Sciences Data and Information Services Center (GES DISC), accessed through NASA GES DISC direct HDF5 download, 1-degree area mean on 2026-11-14.
